description: Planungsgrundlage Windenergie und Auerhuhn is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by metadaten.geoportal-bw.de. The planning basis for wind power and capercaillie has been developed on the basis of nature conservation regulations, the updated action plan for capercaillie as well as many years of scientific work on the effects of wind turbines on the capercaillie. For more information: Status: 2023. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Planning basis for wind energy and capercaillie" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
